faq.q: Why is there no townhome-only market figure?
faq.a: Because the only permitted stats source does not publish one: SnapStats splits attached product only as "Condos & Townhomes" combined, at community level for medians — the combined September 2026 medians for the feed's confirmed communities were Surrey $512,944, Langley $611,000 and Cloverdale $740,000, none of which is a townhome figure (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in this area?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: Are townhomes in this area freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
